verdict.rationale: Any product with a web presence could publish llms.txt or agent-oriented docs, so this story applies to CT Corporation. The evidence shows no such resource. The main host www.wolterskluwer.com answers even robots.txt with a Cloudflare challenge (HTTP 403) to a keyless agent. The legacy ct.wolterskluwer.com host 301-redirects its content pages into that walled host, so no agent-readable documentation is reachable. Because the probes never fetched an llms.txt path, the absence is inferred rather than directly confirmed, which is why confidence is medium.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
